title: Umbilical Cord Fell Off
desc: A small but significant milestone — the last physical connection to those nine months of growing together.
story: Five days after coming home, we noticed it during your morning nappy change — the little cord stump had finally fallen away. It felt oddly momentous, like closing a chapter. That tiny cord had kept you nourished and safe for nine months. Now it was gone, and your little belly button was perfectly formed. Another sign that you were settling into the world outside. We couldn't bring ourselves to let it go though — we kept it safe with us, a tiny keepsake of the bond we shared before you even arrived.
